prTitle: fix: handle collective multiple host on destinationCalendar

prOriginalConhecido.nota: Upstream calcom/cal.com now redirects to calcom/cal.diy. Found by head branch fix-collective-events-have-only-one-team-attendee-on-the-google-event-7754-cal-1267; benchmark head de62829 is the PR's last commit and squash c4e5d168 has the same 22-file diff (only unrelated main-merge drift in imports). Files later moved: EventManager -> packages/features/bookings/lib, CalendarManager -> packages/features/calendars/lib, handleNewBooking -> service/RegularBookingService + handleNewBooking/loadUsers.

tps.bug: When rescheduling merges into a new booking, only the first old `_calendar` reference is deleted via `.find()`, leaving stale events on other hosts' calendars for collective bookings; iterate all old calendar references.
tps.evidenciaOpus: The PR makes updateAllCalendarEvents handle multiple `_calendar` references (EventManager.ts:496-551, find->filter) for collective multi-host bookings, but the merge cleanup at EventManager.ts:553-564 still uses `.find()` and deletes only the first old calendar event, leaving stale events on the other hosts' calendars.
tps.evidenciaAstra: The PR creates events for multiple destination calendars in packages/core/EventManager.ts:338-377, but merge cleanup still selects just one old reference and deletes only its event at lines 553-563. Collective booking merges reach this branch through packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking.ts:1483-1486, leaving the other hosts’ old events behind. This affects rescheduling into an existing booking; ordinary rescheduling updates all references.
